items.title: OpenAI claims a solution to Navier-Stokes
items.summary: OpenAI said a group of AI agents, running a next-generation model more capable than GPT-6 Astra, had produced a solution to the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem in 88 hours. The announcement got 120K likes, and the pushback was nearly as big: a post accusing OpenAI of overclaiming got 68K.
items.author: @OpenAI
